top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §744.303(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not report a change in director.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was pending 10 hours of annual training hours.    One out of four employees was pending 6 hours in business.

top_violation_types.title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operations director still lacked annual required training topics.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §744.2007(b)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During an inspection, children were observed watching a movie and exceeding the one hour time limit.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §744.2007(b)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child in care was observed playing a shoot age on his personal ipad.

top_violation_types.title: Director Present During Operating Hours (26 TAC §744.1011)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operation is operating without a designated site director in charge.
